This is source-specific permission, not a public-domain claim for all government data.

sources.rightsBasis: Yandex Maps API terms restrict exporting, storing and modifying service data except permitted SDK caching; no agreement authorizing a public camera database has been established.

access.note: Yandex search returned SmartCaptcha; no bypass attempted. API documentation is a reference, not a bulk feed.

sources.rightsBasis: Mapcam project rules section 9.3 require agreement for redistribution of the database or any part; section 1.8 prohibits bots. A normal application subscription is not a redistribution agreement.
sources.attribution: Mapcam.info; separate agreement required for data reuse

sources.rightsBasis: Airbits identifies RadarBase as its source. An open bulk-export API and permission to republish the database were not established; no blanket prohibition is inferred from this absence.
sources.attribution: RadarBase.info / Airbits; obtain an appropriate data agreement

sources.rightsBasis: HUD Speed is a consumer of RadarBase, not an independent corroborating database. No public redistribution agreement has been established.
GPS Antiradar is a consumer of RadarBase, not an independent corroborating database. No public redistribution agreement has been established.

Radarbot terms dated 2026-02-04 section 12 restrict extracting, reusing or reproducing its radar database outside the application. A limited-partner SDK is offered, but no agreement for this project exists.
sources.attribution: Radarbot / Iteration Mobile; partner terms required

sources.rightsBasis: Indexed Speedcamonline pages require attribution and agreement for commercial use. Current permission for this project's public database redistribution is not established; this is not classified as an explicit universal redistribution ban.
sources.attribution: Speedcamonline.ru and original curator/source; confirm applicable agreement

access.note: Direct root HTTPS returned HTTP 503 during this research. Cached search results are not a verified current export.

sources.rightsBasis: The official consumer app documentation describes a collection including Speedcamonline/RD-forum and checked user reports. Overlapping app/feed evidence is conservatively one source family; a public redistribution agreement is not established.
eStrelka shares a collection of sources with Strelka/Speedcamonline; its text import feature does not establish a license to redistribute the underlying collection.

OpenSpeedcam describes itself as a freely editable open database of road danger points: all points are available for correction, update and download, free of charge. Only static enforcement-related point kinds are imported, each with a per-point source link.
